title: Subsets
prompt: Given an integer array nums of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set). The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets. Return the solution in any order.
constraints: All the numbers of nums are unique.
hints: Backtrack: for each index, either include the element or not. Build path, when we have processed all indices, add path to result.
DFS: start with empty, at each step either skip current element or add it and recurse. After adding, backtrack (pop).
At each level: add current subset to result, then for each remaining element, add it, recurse, remove it.
